about: Recorded sizes in bytes of the shipped engine binaries, checked by tools/binary-budget.py (issue 551). A binary may be at most `tolerance` above its budget. Start of the ratchet: the size table of issue 551 (main 2ff4472d2 + PR 540, macOS arm64; Wasm from the same build). Lower a budget with `tools/binary-budget.py check --update`; raise one only by hand, in a reviewed change that says why. leanjs darwin-arm64 raised 11,420,160 -> 11,868,032 B (+3.9%) at the merge of main 8d3af851b: PRs merged since (550 undo log in JS/UndoLog and the evaluator, 547/549, 537) grew it; measured on the merged state. leanjs darwin-arm64 lowered 11,868,032 -> 11,483,024 B (-3.2%): the undo log's logging branch is a call (HeapOf.noteObjOn, noteEnvOn), not expanded at each heap write. web-render.wasm raised 49,542,896 -> 50,703,168 B and web-render.wasm.br 5,925,520 -> 6,066,156 B (owner-approved 2026-11-17, PR 590): main had already grown to +1.51% (50,289,963 B at e5ab9084b) and the ten WPT branches of PR 590 add about 412 KB (+0.82%) for +3,110 WPT subtests; no cheap trim was found. Measured on build.yml 44119004965. Rebaseline web-render.wasm and web-render.wasm.br to 52,592,214 and 6,293,040 B, respectively, measured on main 14fbe357d906 in build.yml 45402939972. The shared Wasm size gate blocked full Foafnaut packaging on macOS. The budget continues to reject growth beyond the existing 2% tolerance. Rebaseline raw web-render.wasm from 52,592,214 to 53,716,995 B, measured at a29700ff2d20 in build.yml 45628462312 after the CSS border, image, list and inline-block work and JavaScript array-length correction. The measured Brotli output was 6,406,093 B and stayed within its existing budget plus tolerance. A reviewed 4,096 B allowance on the compressed runtime raises its budget from 6,293,040 to 6,297,136 B. Exact native-verified form editing, canvas sizing and accessible-name packages built to 6,420,309, 6,420,747 and 6,421,704 B in runs 45700207024, 45699806786 and 45702502234. These missed the old 6,418,900 B maximum by 1,409 to 2,804 B. The 2% tolerance gives an absolute ceiling of 6,423,078 B. Rebaseline the compressed renderer to 6,424,457 B, the measured output of merged main 5d4a43662939 in build.yml 45692334484 job 139522164645. The complete browser release measured 1,379 B above the ceiling after the earlier four-KiB allowance. The existing 2% growth check applies to the new reference. Set web-render.wasm.br to a 200,000-byte absolute growth allowance, matching the starting compressed allowance in issue 551; raw binaries retain the 2% tolerance. Rebaseline the Foafnaut 0.38.1 browser renderer to the measured release-candidate sizes 56,085,800 B raw and 6,694,464 B Brotli after the Web Audio, SVG and navigation work (build 46041505276, job 140650234378). The raw 2% tolerance and the 200,000-byte Brotli allowance still apply.
